messages.content: Write RACF command to define a dataset profile

JCL (Job Control Language) is the control language for z/OS batch processing. It defines:

1. JOB Statement - Job identification, accounting, class
2. EXEC Statement - Program or procedure to execute
3. DD Statements - Dataset definitions (input/output files)

Key concepts:
- DISP parameter controls dataset disposition
- DCB defines dataset characteristics
- SPACE allocates disk space
- COND/IF controls step execution
- Procedures (PROCs) allow reusable JCL
Write CICS COBOL to read a file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSREAD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                   FROM(WS-DATA)
                   LENGTH(90)
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX SCHEMA.CUST_IDX1
    ON SCHEMA.CUSTOMER (CUST_ID ASC)
    USING STOGROUP SYSDEFLT
    PRIQTY 100
    SECQTY 50
    BUFFERPOOL BP0;

CREATE INDEX SCHEMA.CUST_IDX2
    ON SCHEMA.CUSTOMER (CUST_NAME ASC, CITY ASC);
Write CICS COBOL to write a file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSWRIT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'NEWKEY001' TO WS-KEY
           MOVE 'NEW CUSTOMER DATA' TO WS-DATA
           EXEC CICS WRITE
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               FROM(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                   FROM('RECORD WRITTEN')
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write JCL for DFSORT with INCLUDE and OUTREC

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VARSAMPLE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME             PIC X(30).
       01 WS-AGE              PIC 99.
       01 WS-SALARY           PIC 9(7)V99.
       01 WS-EDIT-SALARY      PIC $ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
       01 WS-DATE.
          05 WS-YEAR          PIC 9(4).
          05 WS-MONTH         PIC 99.
          05 WS-DAY           PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'JOHN DOE' TO WS-NAME
           MOVE 35 TO WS-AGE
           MOVE 75000.50 TO WS-SALARY
           MOVE WS-SALARY TO WS-EDIT-SALARY
           DISPLAY 'NAME: ' WS-NAME
           DISPLAY 'AGE: ' WS-AGE
           DISPLAY 'SALARY: ' WS-EDIT-SALARY
           STOP RUN.
Write JCL to compile a COBOL program

DB2 is IBM's relational database management system for z/OS mainframes. Key features:

1. SQL Support - Standard SQL for data manipulation
2. High Availability - Data sharing, disaster recovery
3. Performance - Optimized for high-volume transactions
4. Security - Row/column level security, encryption
5. Integration - Works with COBOL, CICS, IMS

DB2 stores data in tablespaces and uses packages/plans for SQL access.
